# FreeCourseWeb.com

> > FreeCourseWeb.com provides free access to professional courses and tutorials across AI engineering, business intelligence, software development, design, marketing, finance, and specialized technical training.

The platform aggregates educational content from sources like Udemy and other providers, offering courses in cutting-edge technologies (GenAI, SwiftUI, TensorFlow, PyTorch), regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, FMEA), business skills, and language learning. Courses range from beginner-friendly tutorials to advanced professional certifications.

## Key Topics

- AI Engineering & Machine Learning
- GenAI & Transformers
- Regulatory Compliance
- Risk Management
- Business Intelligence
- Data Analytics & Visualization
- SwiftUI & Mobile Development
- HVAC Safety & Refrigeration
- Email Marketing & Automation
- Ergonomic Design
- Blockchain & Cryptocurrency
- Critical Thinking
- Language Learning
- Professional Certification
- Beginner-Friendly Courses

## AI & Machine Learning Engineering

- [GenAI Engineering Sprint: Code, Deploy, Scale, Repeat](https://freecourseweb.com/tutorialsv4/it-software/genai-engineering-sprint-code-deploy-scale-repeat): Deploy GenAI apps with Python, Streamlit & cloud platforms like Google Run
- [AI Engineer Professional Certificate Course](https://freecourseweb.com/tutorialsv4/development/ai-engineer-professional-certificate-course): Professional AI engineering with TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLOps & transformers
- [EU AI Act Masterclass: Compliance, Risk & Governance 2025](https://freecourseweb.com/tutorialsv4/it-software/eu-ai-act-masterclass-compliance-risk-and-governance-2025): EU AI Act compliance masterclass covering GDPR integration & risk mgmt
- [Supercharge Your Business Growth: AI & Automation for SMEs](https://freecourseweb.com/tutorialsv4/business/supercharge-your-business-growth-ai-and-automation-for-smes): AI automation & productivity tools for small business growth

## Business Intelligence & Data Analytics

- [Microsoft Excel Data Visualization with Charts & Graphs](https://freecourseweb.com/tutorialsv4/office-productivity/microsoft-excel-data-visualization-with-charts-and-graphs): Excel course on creating charts, graphs, dashboards & visual storytelling
- [Business Math for the Math-Averse](https://freecourseweb.com/tutorialsv4/finance-accounting/business-math-for-the-math-averse): Beginner business math with Excel: ROI, financial analysis & accounting
